user.title: Ferroamp Control
user.description: Writable control of the Ferroamp EnergyHub over the local MQTT ExtAPI. The prefix must match the one EMS drives (default 'ferroamp'). Control stays OFF until you enable the 'Ferroamp control enabled' switch.

data.base_topic: Ferroamp ExtAPI MQTT base topic (commands go to <base>/control/request)
